meta.title: 社交接话快慢，暴露你的知识体系
meta.title_en: How Fast You Respond Shows What You Know

scenes.title_cn: 接话速度：知识体系的照妖镜
scenes.title_en: Response speed: a mirror of what you know
scenes.context: 讲者指出别人话排山倒海而来自己却毫无反应很尴尬，社交餐桌上的角力靠接话速度分辨高手与平庸者，背后是知识体系的较量。
sentences: 有时候脑子反应不过来，别人的话排山倒海朝你扑面而来，自己却没有任何反应。
Sometimes your mind goes blank — their words come at you in waves, and you have nothing to say.
反应不过来：your mind goes blank
看接话的速度，他能不能在别人抛出一个问题时立马把话接上去。
Watch how fast they respond — can they pick up the topic the moment someone raises a question?
接话：pick up the topic
这其实是你背后知识体系的较量。
It's really a battle between your knowledge systems.
知识体系：knowledge system
paraphrase: 接不上话 → 不是嘴笨是储备不足
Going blank isn't shyness — it's a lack of ammunition.
判断高手 → 看接话速度
Spot the real deal by how fast they respond.
scenes.speak: Sometimes your mind goes blank — their words come at you in waves, and you have nothing to say. Watch how fast they respond — can they pick up the topic the moment someone raises a question? It's really a battle between your knowledge systems.

scenes.title_en: Trick one: summarize to steal time
scenes.context: 讲者给出第一个方法：不管对方说什么，先认可并用自己的话复述，边讲边想，最后无缝衔接自己的观点，这个方法叫偷时间。
sentences: 不管对方说什么，你都可以快速反应：刚才的说法很有道理、很有意思。
No matter what they say, you can respond instantly: that's a great point, really interesting.
快速反应：respond instantly
然后用你自己的话把它的话再讲一遍，边说边想，给自己大脑反应时间。
Then rephrase their point in your own words — buying your brain time as you speak.
给自己反应时间：buy yourself time
总结完之后，再无缝连接到自己的观点和看法。这个耍赖皮的方法叫做偷时间。
Then smoothly bridge to your own take. This sneaky move is called stealing time.
无缝连接：bridge smoothly
paraphrase: 复述 ≠ 拍马屁 → 边讲边想
Rephrasing isn't flattery — it buys thinking time.
接话顺序 → 先说对方再说自己
Echo first, then connect to your own take.
scenes.speak: No matter what they say, you can respond instantly: that's a great point, really interesting. Then rephrase their point in your own words — buying your brain time as you speak. Then smoothly bridge to your own take. This sneaky move is called stealing time.

scenes.context: 讲者给出第二个方法：找出对方观点的隐含前提并掀翻它，让对方的积累失效；并提供通用句式「XX只是一方面，还要看很多方面」。
sentences: 比如对方说中年人去健身房减肥最重要的是先减脂，你就改变他的前提。
If they say cutting fat is the key to losing weight at the gym, flip their premise.
改变前提：flip the premise
你把他的前提给掀翻了，他大量的知识就被塞回到热水瓶里面，倒不出来了。
Once you flip their premise, their whole knowledge stash gets bottled up — useless.
掀翻前提：topple the premise
你可以说，器具只是一方面，还要看饭店的环境、蘸羊肉的小料、汤底、价格、服务等等。
You can say, the cookware is only one factor — consider the setting, the dipping sauce, the broth, the price, the service.
只是一方面：only one factor
paraphrase: 对方观点 → 找到前提再推翻
Find the hidden assumption, then topple it.
知识失效 → 接话主动
Their expertise goes stale; you take the lead.
scenes.speak: If they say cutting fat is the key to losing weight at the gym, flip their premise. Once you flip their premise, their whole knowledge stash gets bottled up — useless. You can say, the cookware is only one factor — consider the setting, the dipping sauce, the broth, the price, the service.

practice: Pick up the topic the moment they raise it.
Rephrase their point to buy yourself some time.
It's only one factor — there's much more to it.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Their words come to you like mountains and seas.
✓ 地道说法：Their words come at you in waves.
in waves 比排山倒海直译更自然。
✓ 地道说法：Pick up the topic.
接「话」实际是接话题，用 topic。
✓ 地道说法：Buy yourself some time.
buy time 是地道表达，steal 字面过重。
✕ 直译腔：The premise was turned over.
✓ 地道说法：Flip the whole premise.
flip the premise 是常用说法。
